how_to_apply: Print the application form (REC-03), which is attached to the official notification, on A4 paper. Fill it in block letters with a blue pen.

Write the post name at the top. Affix a recent passport-size photo without stapling it. Fill in your personal details, educational qualifications from SSLC onwards, previous employment and language proficiency.

Complete the optional sections: your experience in up to 500 words, research experience or publications, whether you are willing to travel to the field, and contact details of previous employers. Then sign the declaration.
Scan the filled form, your CV and supporting documents into one PDF. Name the file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_DEO_2023_application".
Email the PDF to [email protected] with the name of the post in the subject line, by 5.00 pm on 5 November 2026.
If you are applying for two or more posts, fill a separate form for each post and send each one with its documents in a separate email.
Documents to attach, all self-attested and in this order:
Proof of identity (Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving Licence)
Certificate showing your age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate)
Experience certificates (proof of work as PDFs)

You must give a valid email ID and mobile number. Applications that are incomplete, not in the prescribed format or do not meet the essential criteria may be rejected without further review. An application with only a CV, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical education and research institute at Dhanvantri Nagar, Puducherry. These posts are in the research project "Heat Exposure Assessment and Labour Tailored Interventions: A Holistic Approach for Building Climate-Resilient Workplaces in Selected Occupational Groups (HEALTH)". ICMR funds the project. It is run by Dr. Palanivel C in the Department of PSM, JIPMER. According to the application form, the work involves travel to the field and to other centres for the study.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of the details in the application, the CV and the documentary proof provided. The list of eligible candidates will also be shown on the JIPMER website. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the written test and/or interview. If there are a very large number of applications, stricter criteria may be used to decide eligibility. The final selection is based on the CV, the application and the written test/interview, and the Project Investigator's decision is final. At the Principal Investigator's discretion, interviews may be held in person or by video conferencing. For an online interview, candidates must arrange their own computer, laptop or mobile with audio and camera, and a stable internet connection. The date and time of the interview will be announced one week in advance. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are on offer in this JIPMER project?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts in total: 1 Project Research Scientist-III (Medical), 3 Project Technical Support-III and 2 Project Technical Support-I, all in the ICMR-funded HEALTH project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: The pay is a consolidated Rs. 21,600 a month, made up of Rs. 18,000 plus 20% HRA, with no other allowances.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply for Project Technical Support-III without a postgraduate degree?
faq.answer: Yes. A graduate degree in any discipline with three years of experience is enough. A PG in public health or environment is the alternative route.

faq.question: Q4. Is Tamil required?
faq.answer: Both Project Technical Support posts require the ability to converse in Tamil fluently. For the Research Scientist post, good communication in Tamil and English is a desirable skill, not a requirement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age for the technical support posts?
faq.answer: The limit is 35 years for Project Technical Support-III and 28 years for Project Technical Support-I, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What should the email subject line and file name be?
faq.answer: Put the name of the post in the subject line. Name the single PDF "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_DEO_2023_application".

faq.question: Q7. Will the interview be held online?
faq.answer: It may be held in person or by video conferencing, as the Principal Investigator decides. The date and time are announced one week in advance.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does this job lead to a permanent post at JIPMER?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract in an externally sponsored project, and the person engaged will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER. The first appointment is for one year, and an extension depends on performance.
